definitions.gloss: packed in a box, boxed, box-packed
definitions.explanation: Items arranged and packed in a box, typically for sale as a gift set or for shipping. Also used as a modifier.

examples.japanese: クッキーの{箱詰|はこづ}めを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a box of cookies.

examples.japanese: お{中元|ちゅうげん}に{果物|くだもの}の{箱詰|はこづ}めを{贈|おく}った。
examples.english: I gave a boxed set of fruit as a midyear gift.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}を{箱詰|はこづ}めにして{発送|はっそう}する。
examples.english: We box up the products and ship them.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from {箱|はこ} (box) + {詰|つ}め (packing). Common in gift-giving and commerce. The same pattern applies to other containers: {袋詰|ふくろづ}め (bagged), {缶詰|かんづ}め (canned).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箱詰|はこづ}めにする: to box up
- {箱詰|はこづ}めの{お菓子|かし}: boxed sweets
- {箱詰|はこづ}め{商品|しょうひん}: boxed product
- {果物|くだもの}の{箱詰|はこづ}め: boxed fruit
